sources: Florida PSC, 'Total Cost for 1,000 kWh - Residential Service', March 2026 (period January-December 2026): https://www.floridapsc.com/pscfiles/website-files/PDF/Utilities/Electricgas/BillingAdjustments/ba_total-2026_oldmar26.pdf
notes: Basic service charge is $0.45 per day, so the monthly amount depends on days in the billing period (default 30).
Tier break at 1,000 kWh applies to the energy charge and to fuel; other clauses are flat per kWh.
Minimum charge is the basic service charge.
Storm surcharge shown as '-' (none) on sheet 6.024.
Gross receipts tax factor 2.5641% is stated on sheet 6.023; franchise fees vary by locality and are excluded.
No seasonal differentiation in schedule RS.
version_note: January insert: storm surcharge 1.995 cents/kWh. The insert says the surcharge runs through August 2026, but tariff Sheet 6.024 effective August 1, 2026 shows none, and the PSC's August table shows $0.00; this version follows the tariff sheet (ends with July).
